item.title: SHAFT 0.86.0
item.description:
Instances can see unfiled meetings, and an unfiled meeting gets an account suggested from its recognised people (#77).

  • Meetings (unfiled) grant: shaft meetings grant <instance> --unfiled, the web Access page and the apps.
  • Suggestion from where the meeting's people's other meetings are filed (two-thirds majority, at least two meetings; the operator's side never counts); never filed automatically. File under <account>? card in the apps, the Meeting ready push and the instance's page header; shaft meetings file <id> --suggested.
